projections.source_time_basis: Retained HYCOM January/July15,2022 00Z snapshots; no new provider fields or independent observations.
projections.projection_gate: Interior maximum of complete finite150–700m westward integral in declared35–36.5N subset; resolved primary5cm/s lower contour.
projections.branch_scope: Partial northern westward Azores Countercurrent-context21–35W reach,with fixed35–36.5N searches inside immutable original Azores source slices. Source latitude context at24.5W_2009 does not establish the2022 axis or a complete current. Meanders beyond gates,opposing eastward Azores jet,recirculation,Portugal/Canary continuations and detached eddies remain separate targets. Broad geographic maxima can be mesoscale/neighboring flow. Neither thermal Mediterranean Water membership nor one coherent branch is independently established. Density-layer extent near2000m and150–700m selection window are not physical bottoms.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.
